profile.name: Thiagarajar College of Engineering
profile.summary: Thiagarajar College of Engineering is a government-aided autonomous college in Madurai, Tamil Nadu. Its current programme directory covers engineering, architecture, interior design, computing and urban planning, including a five-year integrated Data Science route. It is a distinct institution from Thiagarajar College, the arts and science college.
profile.campusLifestyle: The college is at Thiruparankundram in Madurai. Its official campus-life pages provide separate men’s and women’s hostel information and a counselling division. Prospective students should check the facilities and admission route relevant to their programme rather than relying on the similarly named arts college.
profile.hostelOverview: The college publishes separate men’s and women’s hostel pages, including warden contacts and links to general, maintenance, discipline and mess information. The women’s hostel page explicitly makes accommodation subject to availability. Confirm the current room charges directly with the hostel office.
profile.dietarySupport: Both hostel sections link mess information. The captured pages do not establish a current menu, special-diet provision or allergy-handling arrangements, so students should ask the relevant hostel office about individual requirements.
profile.studentSupport: The college’s counselling cell operates at the campus health centre. Its official page describes a tutor–ward system and tele-counselling service, and a link with Chella Muthu Trust Research Foundation for counsellor orientation and training.
whyChoose: UGC’s own register confirms autonomous status for the engineering college.
The portfolio extends beyond engineering into design, architecture, computing and planning.
Separate hostel contacts and a dedicated counselling division are published.
thingsToConsider: This is not Thiagarajar College at tcarts.in.
Some admission pages contain legacy examination or threshold wording that needs current-cycle checking.
TNEA engineering access includes only specified OCI/PIO and refugee categories; an unrestricted foreign-national route and current fee categories are not established.
bestFitFor: Students comparing engineering disciplines in the Madurai region.
Applicants seeking the specifically listed integrated Data Science or planning route.
Research applicants who can verify an Anna University-recognized supervisor and current call.

faq.question: Is this Thiagarajar College of Engineering or the arts college?
faq.answer: This is Thiagarajar College of Engineering at Thiruparankundram, Madurai, with official website tce.edu. It is not the separately published Thiagarajar College at tcarts.in.

faq.question: What does autonomous status mean for this listing?
faq.answer: UGC’s own autonomous-colleges register identifies Thiagarajar College of Engineering, Madurai, affiliated to Anna University, with autonomy shown for 2022–23 through 2031–32.

faq.question: How many taught programmes are in the current directory?
faq.answer: The captured directory lists 22 taught awards: 12 engineering bachelor’s routes, B.Arch., B.Des., integrated M.Sc. Data Science, five M.E. routes, MCA and M.Plan.

faq.question: How long is B.Des. Interior Design?
faq.answer: The official programme directory lists B.Des. Interior Design as four years. A secondary fee page describing a three-year course conflicts with that source and is not used.

faq.question: Is Data Science a regular two-year M.Sc.?
faq.answer: No. The listed M.Sc. Data Science is a five-year integrated programme. It should not be mapped to a conventional two-year postgraduate M.Sc.

faq.question: Does the college list postgraduate planning?
faq.answer: Yes. The current directory includes a two-year M.Plan in Urban Planning. Its current eligibility, admission examination and fee category should be checked before applying.

faq.question: Are all research centres current open PhD places?
faq.answer: No. The research admissions page lists recognized centres and M.S./Ph.D. routes through Anna University. That does not establish a current vacancy under every supervisor or in every discipline.

faq.question: Are hostel places guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. The women’s hostel page expressly says accommodation is subject to availability. Separate hostel pages provide warden contacts, and applicants should confirm an allocation before relying on a room.

faq.question: What counselling support is published?
faq.answer: The college describes a counselling cell at the health centre, a tutor–ward system and tele-counselling. The page also identifies training support through Chella Muthu Trust Research Foundation.

faq.question: Are the fee figures on comparison sites sufficient?
faq.answer: Not on their own. The reviewed secondary fee page mixes course-family ranges, older schedules and a B.Des. duration conflict. Request a current programme- and category-specific quotation rather than treating those figures as annual tuition.

faq.question: Are current international admissions confirmed?
faq.answer: For engineering, TNEA 2026 permits only specified Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO and Sri Lankan Tamil refugee applicants, subject to its restrictions. This is not global foreign-national access. International eligibility for the other listed awards remains unverified.

profile.cityProfile: Thiagarajar College of Engineering is based at Thiruparankundram in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, with the official postal address Madurai 625015. Students should plan housing and daily travel around this engineering-college campus, rather than the separate Thiagarajar College arts and science institution.
profile.practicalExposure: TCE describes a CDIO approach—Conceive, Design, Implement and Operate—to curriculum design, teaching and assessment, with hands-on training. Its About page also identifies industry-supported laboratories, collaborative projects and internships, including curriculum work with TVS Motors in mechanical and electrical engineering. Availability depends on the programme and activity; no placement is guaranteed.
profile.safetyOverview: TCE’s mandatory disclosure identifies a grievance-redressal mechanism for students, staff and faculty, and lists medical facilities and student insurance. Its counselling division operates at the campus health centre. Applicants should verify current access arrangements rather than assume round-the-clock emergency coverage.

admissionsContent.overview: This four-year engineering programme uses TCE’s published single-window route. The requirements below describe TNEA 2026 academic-stream applications, not every management, foreign-national or vocational pathway.
applicationSteps: Register one application through the official TNEA portal and enter academic, school, identity and relevant category details.
Upload the required certificates for verification, then follow the notified counselling, choice-filling and allotment process.
Complete TCE reporting only against the allotted programme and comply with its verified document and fee instructions.
admissionsContent.deadlinesNote: These are the 2026 route conditions. All relevant 2026 counselling dates must be treated as historical; check the next published cycle before applying.

eligibility.intro: TNEA 2026 requires the appropriate nationality/nativity category and a pass in both higher-secondary years or equivalent. This summary covers the academic stream.
items: General category: at least 45% average in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry at Class XII.
BC/BCM, MBC/DNC and SC/SCA/ST: at least 40% average in those subjects, subject to the applicable category rules.
TNEA nativity, Tamil Nadu schooling or specified parental-service conditions apply.
Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO applicants are permitted under the brochure’s restrictions; foreign-country births after 4 March 2021 are excluded under that OCI/PIO provision.
The brochure has a separate prescribed vocational stream; do not substitute academic-stream subject rules for vocational applicants.

Academic qualifications, category documents and counselling allotment are required.
